### Step 1 — Scene
A raw snack-style meal: a whole apple, almonds, cherry/grape tomatoes, dark grapes, and spinach leaves.

### Step 2 — Vessel
A shallow dinner plate, approximately **26 cm diameter**.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### Step 3 — Items
Visible foods: apple, almonds, spinach, tomatoes, and grapes. No visible oil, dressing, or sauce.

### Steps 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas are estimated without double-counting overlapping foods. Heights represent average pile thickness, not maximum height.

| Item | Plate area | Area (cm²) | Avg. height (cm) | Gross volume (ml) | Bulk density (g/ml) | Weight (g) | kcal/100 g | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Whole apple | 9% | 48 | 4.5 | 215 | 0.85 | 183 | 52 | 95 |
| Almonds | 17% | 90 | 1.15 | 104 | 0.60 | 62 | 579 | 359 |
| Spinach leaves | 15% | 80 | 1.8 | 143 | 0.15 | 21 | 23 | 5 |
| Cherry/grape tomatoes | 7% | 37 | 2.4 | 89 | 0.65 | 58 | 18 | 10 |
| Dark grapes | 5% | 27 | 2.0 | 53 | 0.65 | 34 | 69 | 23 |
| **Total** | **53%** | **282** | | | | **358** | | **492** |

The apple uses a whole-fruit density; the other densities account for gaps within each pile.

### Step 8 — Sanity check
About half the plate is covered. A medium apple, a substantial handful of almonds, a few tomatoes and grapes, and a small amount of spinach plausibly weigh **about 360 g**, providing **about 490 kcal**. Almonds supply most of the energy.
